named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findRoot
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,DECODE(NVL(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status),'Y', 1, 'C',1,'L',2,0) as status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree, esq_user, esq_account WHERE usr_pk (+)= tree_usr_pk AND acc_pk (+)= tree_acc_pk AND tree_pk = :rootId AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findByEntityId
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,DECODE(NVL(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status),'Y', 1, 'C',1,'L',2,0) as status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree, esq_user, esq_account WHERE usr_pk (+)= tree_usr_pk AND acc_pk (+)= tree_acc_pk AND tree_entity_pk = :id AND tree_tree_pk_link IS NULL AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findByNameKind
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,DECODE(NVL(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status),'Y', 1, 'C',1,'L',2,0) as status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree, esq_user, esq_account WHERE usr_pk (+)= tree_usr_pk AND acc_pk (+)= tree_acc_pk AND tree_name = :name AND tree_et_pk = :kind AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findNodes
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_pk ,tree_tree_pk_parent ,tree_tree_pk_link ,tree_name ,tree_et_pk ,DECODE(NVL(usr_deleted_flg, acc_status),'Y', 1, 'C',1,'L',2,0) as status_code ,tree_entity_pk ,tree_level - :rootLevel AS tree_level ,tree_desc ,tree_path FROM esq_tree, esq_user, esq_account WHERE usr_pk (+)= tree_usr_pk AND acc_pk (+)= tree_acc_pk AND tree_tree_pk_parent = :id AND tree_entity_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqTreeNodeJpa.findPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT tree_path FROM esq_tree WHERE tree_pk = :id AND tree_tree_pk_link IS NULL FETCH NEXT 1 ROWS ONLY
